sources.title: MYACTUATOR RH original documentation archive
sources.locator: RH User Manual V1.4 §§5–8; RH-17 product manual 260805; EtherCAT control protocol V2.0_260425
sources.verified_fact: 48 V nominal / 55 V maximum module input; brake takes power from module DC input; RH17 has RES interface; ECAT actual pin assignment follows product labels. Factory harness order codes and regeneration ratings unresolved.

sources.title: Beckhoff C6015-0040 configuration
sources.verified_fact: C9900-C657 2-core X7213RE / 8 GB; C9900-H855 80 GB SSD; C9900-M602 DIN mounting; two 100/1000/2500BASE-T ports.

sources.title: Beckhoff TwinCAT/BSD ordering
sources.verified_fact: C9900-S602 platform 40 includes C601x up to two cores in all generations.

sources.title: Beckhoff TC1250
sources.verified_fact: TC1250 combines PLC and NC PTP 10; includes TC1200 + TF5000; TwinCAT/BSD listed. Current catalog template TC1250-0v40; v field and build to be quoted.

sources.title: Beckhoff C6015 technical data
sources.verified_fact: 22–30 V DC, NEC Class 2 supply. Actual selected configuration power and X101 pin numbering to be confirmed against shipped generation manual.

sources.title: Keysight E36232A product
sources.verified_fact: Single-channel 0–60 V / 0–10 A / 200 W autoranging supply. No regenerative-sink claim made.

sources.title: Keysight E36200 data sheet
sources.verified_fact: CV/CC, OVP/OCP and slew controls. INH is pin 3; common pin 4 chassis-grounded; +16.5/-5 V maximum digital-pin rating. Includes output and digital mating terminal blocks.

sources.title: Keysight E36200 programming guide
sources.verified_fact: LATChing/LIVE/OFF modes; INH configuration and power-cycle/re-arm behavior require bench verification.

sources.title: PULS ML60.242
sources.locator: Output technical data (use body, not misleading 3 A page title)
sources.verified_fact: 24 V / 2.5 A / 60 W; NEC Class 2; 250 g. Selected auxiliary branch only, pending IPC boot-load budget.

sources.title: PULS ML60.242 data sheet
sources.verified_fact: Installation, loading, backfeed and protection conditions govern enclosed integration.

sources.title: Phoenix UK 5-HESI
sources.verified_fact: Fuse holder 5×20/25/30 mm, rated 6.3 A. Does not include the fuse or establish its DC interruption rating.

sources.title: Littelfuse 477 fuse data sheet
sources.verified_fact: 0477004.MXP: time-lag 4 A, 5×20 mm, 400 V DC rated. Candidate only; inrush/I²t/fault coordination unresolved.

sources.title: Schneider C60H-DC
sources.verified_fact: 2-pole 4 A C-curve DC circuit breaker. Polarity, trip curve, backfeed and isolation application require final circuit review.

sources.title: Phoenix UT 2,5
sources.verified_fact: Feed-through terminal; D-UT 2,5/10 3047028 end cover and CLIPFIX 35-5 3022276 end bracket.

sources.title: Phoenix UT 2,5-PE
sources.verified_fact: Protective conductor terminal; bonding and conductor section still circuit-dependent.

sources.title: Schneider XALK178G
sources.verified_fact: Twist-release mushroom station with 2 NC + 1 NO; control contacts, not direct 48 V motor-load switching.

sources.title: Pilz PNOZ s5
sources.verified_fact: 24 V DC safety relay, 2 immediate NO + 2 delayed NO. Component selection does not certify complete bench.

sources.title: Pilz PNOZ s5 operating manual
sources.verified_fact: Input wiring, monitored start, contact limits and delay settings must follow selected operating mode; delay not frozen.

sources.title: Omron G9EJ-1-E data sheet
sources.verified_fact: G9EJ-1-E-UVD DC24: SPST-NO, 24 V coil, polarized power contacts, 15 A at 400 V DC resistive; 45 g. Coil suppression requires varistor or diode plus Zener, not diode alone. No mirror-contact claim.

sources.title: Phoenix PLC-RSC-24DC/21AU
sources.verified_fact: 24 V coil, gold small-signal contact. Actual low-current PSU inhibit interface and contact wetting to be qualified.

sources.title: Mean Well RSP-1000
sources.verified_fact: 48 V / 21 A / 1008 W whole-arm candidate. Not the selected first-axis supply.

sources.title: Beckhoff EtherCAT RJ45 patch cable
sources.verified_fact: ZK1090-9191-0010: 1 m, RJ45 male both ends, shielded Cat.5 PUR 4×2×AWG26; fixed installation; 5.9±0.2 mm OD, fixed bend radius 5×OD.
